external_games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Delta Chronicles DLC

name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Delta Chronicles
summary:
Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Delta Chronicles adds new missions, recruitable heroes, six technologies, and four NPC ships to your Delta Quadrant journey. It includes storylines such as a Talaxian colony under threat, a debate over Dr. Gegen’s “Distant Origin Theory,” and choices that affect Voyager’s ability to return home.

New playable/available characters include Reginald Barclay and Dr. Forra Gegen, alongside allied options like the Ferengi Marauder and additional ships such as the Voth City Ship, Allos’ Ship, and Nocona’s Ship.
